title: Every etale structure-sheaf module on a zero-dimensional local scheme is quasi-coherent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: An arbitrary module sheaf must be reconstructed from global sections, not merely checked on a given affine presentation. The proof reduces every etale object to finite local etale algebras and uses semilinear Galois descent twice to handle both Galois and non-Galois residue extensions.
